comparison.objective: Load and orient four blanks into a close-clearance gravity magazine; candidate adjusts and tests a hydraulic damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests repeated grasping, yaw alignment, release into a narrow channel, and stacking. Candidate tests fine hex insertion, captive locking, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and response-driven adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR scores the number of flat, supported, stationary blanks fully inside the magazine. Candidate requires two consecutive compliant carriage stops with no hard-stop strike, overload, rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Close-clearance insertion and stacking do not test mechanical adjustment, retention, or dynamic energy absorption.
